title: Chocolate Rum Balls
description: Quick, fun, and dangerously delicious — the ultimate no-bake chocolate treat.

ingredients.notes: plain, from leftover sponge or mud cake

method.instruction: Place cake crumbs and cocoa powder into a large mixing bowl and combine.
Add warmed apricot jam, dark rum, and hot water. Mix until the dough is sticky but firm enough to roll.
Scoop approximately 2 teaspoons of mixture and roll into balls. Repeat until all dough is used.
Roll each ball in chocolate sprinkles until fully coated.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours before serving to allow flavours to meld and the balls to firm up.

notes.title: Cake Crumbs
notes.content: Leftover chocolate mud cake or plain sponge works best. Day-old cake is ideal — it absorbs the rum and jam without going soggy. Blitz in a food processor for even crumbs.

notes.title: Variations
notes.content: Substitute rum with brandy, Tia Maria, or Kahlua. Roll in desiccated coconut instead of sprinkles for a different finish.

notes.title: Storage
notes.content: Keep refrigerated in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks. The flavour deepens after a day or two.
